resourceModel.upstreamDerivation: The pinned OpenTURNS implementation performs all-variable quadratic kernel work and recomputes the statistic for each output permutation, so dimensions and permutations multiply rather than add.

auditAnswers.hiddenLoopNesting: Yes. OpenTURNS computes quadratic kernel statistics across every input and repeats the permutation statistic B times, so n squared, dimension, and permutations are multiplicative.
auditAnswers.maximumConfiguration: The schema maximum n=2000, d=8, B=2000 estimates 72,144,000,000 units and is rejected before model sampling because it exceeds the 150,000,000-unit cap.
auditAnswers.uiMaximumDimension: For the eight-input damped oscillator at B=100, n=400 estimates 149,760,000 units and is admitted while n=401 estimates 150,509,736 and is rejected; the browser contract clamps the shared sample budget to 400.

interpretationBoundaries: Global HSIC is a sample- and bandwidth-dependent association measure; it does not establish causal influence.
Permutation p-values test sampled independence under the declared distribution and do not allocate output variance or prove predictive validity outside that distribution.
